concerns.text: Task T015 (implementing FR-010 fail-fast logic) is marked incomplete. FR-010 mandates termination with non-zero exit code if valid subjects < 50. Without this task, the system cannot satisfy the hard constraint of failing on insufficient data, violating FR-010.

Task T016b (aggregating mean ventral striatum activation) is marked incomplete. FR-002 requires extracting VS ROI time series, and US-3 requires correlating flexibility with 'ventral striatum activation magnitudes'. T016b is the only task producing the scalar metric required for FR-005; its absence breaks the data flow for the core research question.

Task T008 (memory-efficient streaming) is marked incomplete. SC-001 and FR-001 mandate processing within 7GB RAM on a free-tier runner. Without explicit implementation of streaming/chunking logic in T008, the pipeline risks OOM failure, violating the hard resource constraint.

Task T030 description uses the vague phrase 'A sufficient number of iterations will be performed' instead of specifying the fixed 1,000 iterations required by FR-006. This semantic weakening makes the permutation test non-deterministic and untestable against the spec's explicit iteration count.

Task T013b (writing session validation metrics) is marked incomplete. SC-005 requires measuring the 'percentage of subjects' passing distinct session ID validation. Without T013b producing `session_validation_metrics.json`, the success criterion SC-005 cannot be verified.

Task T025 (handling zero-variance flexibility scores) is marked incomplete. The spec Edge Cases and FR-004 imply excluding subjects with zero variance to avoid undefined statistics. T025b (filtering data) depends on T025's exclusion logic; without T025, the data alignment for correlation is unsupported.
